promptLatex: A factory makes a quarter of its output on line A, a third on line B, and the rest on line C. Line A inspects every item itself and never ships a defective one, while lines B and C each ship 10 percent defective. An item drawn at random from the shipment is not defective. What is the probability that it came from line C?
hintLatex: Line A can never produce an item matching the evidence, so its weight is zero and it must not enter the total.
In a batch of $120$ items the shares are $30$, $40$, and $50$, and the sound items are $30$, $36$, and $45$.
So $111$ sound items were shipped and $45$ of them came from line C.
